entries.wording: Waiting To Pickup By Customer location
entries.note: The first line of a waybill: booked, waiting at the sender's premises for a pickup. Domex's customer is the sender.
A branch took the parcel in, the origin branch or the delivering one; the page names the branch after "By".
A branch sent the parcel to the sorting hub.
Left the sorting hub for a branch.
The morning after a delivery round that did not deliver: the delivery moved to another day.
Kept at the delivering branch, after it took the parcel in or after a round; in the histories seen it repeats day after day until another round or a return.
The delivering branch sent the parcel back through the hub towards the sender's branch.
The sender's branch handing the parcel back to the sender.
The return to the sender confirmed.
The head office's finance department closing the waybill days after a return; it moves nothing.
